##### Project general facts

Alef Noon Residence by Al Bait Al Duwaliy is a contemporary residential tower that blends traditional and modern architectural design. Elegant forms and generous landscaped terraces give the building a refined, welcoming character. The tower rises above a basement parking level, a ground floor with retail units and a three-level podium to sixteen residential floors and a roof. The project offers studios, one-bedroom apartments and one-bedroom apartments with an extra room, designed for both residents and investors.

Amenities support a comfortable, balanced everyday routine. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool and a fully equipped gym, together with a kids' play area and open landscaped spaces for relaxing outdoors. Covered parking and electric vehicle charging points add convenience, while retail units at ground level bring daily essentials close to home. A welcoming lobby, lifts, round-the-clock security and CCTV complete the shared facilities for residents and their guests.

Interiors are sleek and contemporary, with practical layouts that make the most of space and natural light. Living and dining areas open onto balconies, while bedrooms offer quiet, comfortable retreats with built-in storage. Apartments with an extra room provide flexible space for a study, a guest room or a maid's room. Central air conditioning is provided throughout, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a master-planned community at the heart of Dubai, known for its circular layout, tree-lined streets and numerous parks. It brings together villas, townhouses and apartment buildings in a family-friendly setting, with Circle Mall serving as the main hub for shopping, dining and entertainment, alongside Jumeirah Park and the Dubai Butterfly Garden close by for families and residents.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect the community with Mall of the Emirates, Al Barsha Mall, Dubai Hills, Dubai Marina Walk and Burj Al Arab. Meydan Racecourse, City Centre Me'aisem and Expo City Dubai are also within easy reach, while schools, nurseries, clinics and supermarkets are spread across the community and in neighbouring districts, making daily life convenient.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community and one of Dubai's most actively traded residential areas. Strong demand from young professionals and families supports high rental yields and steady occupancy. A central position, mature infrastructure and a wide choice of ready homes keep the area popular with both investors and end users seeking accessible entry points within a well-connected part of the city.
